name: todo
description: A private log of your daily work, todos and goals, for performance reviews.
author: kuklaph

scripts.dev: bun run scripts/copy-notes.ts && bun run --watch src/dev-server.ts
scripts.demo: rm -rf demo-vault && bun run scripts/seed-demo.ts && VAULT_PATH=demo-vault bun run --watch src/dev-server.ts
scripts.check: bun run secrets && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.build:main: bun build src/electron/main.ts --target=node --format=esm --external electron --external electron-updater --outfile out/main.js
scripts.verify:mcp: bun run build:main && bun run scripts/verify-mcp.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:main && bun run package:win
scripts.build:release: bun run check && bun run secrets:history && bun run build:main && bun run secrets:build && bun run package:win
